notes.title: Last weekend, on June 28–29
notes.content:
[p][b]✌🏻 Hey yo, everyone!
We’re sharing some exciting news with you:[/b][/p][p]🌿 Last weekend, on June 28–29, our Cryolite Games team attended the “Ysyakh Tuymaady” festival — an annual large-scale national traditional celebration of summer held by the Sakha (Yakutian) people of the North. This spring-summer festival honors the god Ayyi, celebrates the revival of nature, and marks the beginning of a new life cycle. The event includes rituals and prayers, abundant feasts and kumis (fermented mare's milk), dancing, folk games, horse races, and competitions for men in traditional sports.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/358f4a3f694a923f6d0cb05ef4c8974f6b729b09.jpg"][/img][/p][p]💻 As part of the annual Republican Exhibition “Sakha Innovations-2025,” dedicated to Inventor’s Day in Russia, visitors will see the latest developments and achievements in innovation, science, and technology from Yakutia.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/7f6326f2dde8d1c1abd39de72aa0f0c92bc16bbc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]😱 It was truly grand! Over 210,000+ guests, a magnificent festival opening, a massive traditional circular dance "osuokhai," rivers of kumis and byrpakh (boiled meat), national dishes, ethnic vibes, powerful and intense traditional sports "Dygin" for real athletes — plus dozens, if not hundreds, of fascinating projects from various participants![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/da00179c179ed0b216fa0aa62926eec158f613ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🍰 And of course, our developer team from Cryolite Games was there too, showcasing our games [i]Cake Up [/i]and [i]Haar [/i]. During the festival, we managed to meet many young developers, students, engineers, and even schoolchildren who, just like you, are eagerly waiting for [i]Cake Up [/i]to launch on Steam.[/p][p]🙏🏻 Congratulations to everyone on the holiday, and thank you all for supporting our indie studio and the [i]Cake Up [/i]development team![/p]

notes.title: Meetup with Urban Jungle developers
notes.content: [h1][b]Cake Up & Urban Jungle[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/466ac32fd1be6ddf940aa41ce400a294fae5ff3e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/4020a3099319e7e123732b8e18720812d6502a4d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Today, we were invited to a meeting by our craft colleagues, the gamedev company [b]Kylyk Games[/b] with their game [b]Urban Jungle[/b] which became a nominee in the most cozy game category at Gamescom 2024. [/h3][h3][b]Urban Jungle [/b]- is a cute and meditative simulation game, where you can decorate your home and create a small blooming oasis by arranging a variety of plants.[/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/99359e870bf88c36141247c9ad1b8b86c1d74fa6.jpg"][/img][/h3][h3]Support the developers of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744010/Urban_Jungle/"]Urban Jungle[/url] game and also add our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557380/Cake_Up/"]Cake Up[/url] game to the desired![/h3][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535194/b6b14d1311ee633b5666f7076473627be2ca4d9d.jpg"][/img][/p]
